Conditioning S=X1∼Beta(1/2,1) and split T∼Beta(1/2,1/2) gives exact arcsine mixture on [s(1−s),(1−s)(1+s)²/4] and displayed density. Independent exact rational moment expansion confirms E[Y]=4/21, E[Y²]=128/3003, Var(Y)=400/63063. At each of three boundary edge midpoints use s=X1 and t=(X2−X3)/2 to derive exact Y−1/4=q−t², with q=s(1/4−s/4−s²/4+t²) and Jacobian density leading 2/(π√q) dq dt. Each such chart gives (2/π)log(1/|η|)+O(1), hence total 6/π. Local simplex-vertex asymptotics produce lower tail 3y/2; Hessian/ellipse at X=(1/3,1/3,1/3) with center density 3√3/(2π) gives upper tail 9δ/2. No other critical values. Correct for Haar directions and nonzero ε only; no atom. Independently checked the Dirichlet algebra and expansions; sampling is corroborative only.
